segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: Good morning. Diane Davies. Can I help you?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: Yes, I'd like to get some insurance for the contents of my home.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: Fine. When did you move into the house?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: A couple of weeks ago, and it's an apartment actually. I was told by the landlord that it would be a good idea to get some insurance for the furniture and other personal possessions. Repeal

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: Fine. Well, let's get some details. What kind of apartment is it?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: It's a two-bedroom apartment.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: What floor is it on?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: Why do you need to know that?

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: Because it affects the cost of the insurance. An apartment on the ground floor isn't as protected as others and there's more chance of a break-in.

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: Really? I didn't know that. It's on the third, no,. .. second floor.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: Second ... and how much is the rent?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: It's $615 per month.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: Good, and where is it located?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: In Biggins St, South Hills.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: I see. And what things did you want to insure? GAVIN Well, what do you recommend?

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: Well, the most important things are those which you would normally find in a home. Things like the television, fridge and so on.

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: I see. Well, I've got a fridge and a stereo system which I've just bought from a friend.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: And how much did you pay for the fridge?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: 50, and the stereo system cost $1,150.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: Have you got a television?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: Yes, but it's very old and not worth much.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: OK. Well, is there anything else you want to insure?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: Yes, I've got a couple of watches and my CDs and books.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: How much do you think they're worth?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: The watches are worth $1,000 ...

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: For both of them?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: No, each one and, all together, the CDs and books cost me about S400.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: OK, so the value of everything you want to insure is $4,000.

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: How much will the insurance cost?

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: Let me see, S4.000 divided by . . . plus 10% . . . right, so this kind of insurance, er, that's Private Contents insurance, it comes to $184.00 for a twelve-month period.

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: S184.00. Well, that sounds pretty good. OK, I'll take that policy.

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: Can I arrange the policy over the phone?

segments.speaker: DIANE.
segments.en: Sure, just let me get the details down. So that's Mr . . .

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: Gavin Murray, that's M-U-R-R-A-Y.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: And the address is?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: It's 16C Biggins Street, South Hills. ,9

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: OK (writing) 16C Biggins Street, South Hills?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: That's right, it's two words, 'South Hills'.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: And your date of birth is?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: 12 November 1980.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: And your contact number?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: Home phone number is 9872 4855.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: Right.. . and er,... you're Australian?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: No . . . I was born in London, although my mother is from Tasmania.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: Really? Whereabouts?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: Hobart.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: I see . . . interesting place. Now, are you working at the moment?

segments.speaker: GAVIN
segments.en: No, I'm a full-time student at Sydney University.

segments.speaker: DIANE
segments.en: Right, good. ,
